title: Fudge So Real, It’s Gross
tagline: Because nothing says 'I care' like a chocolate log that makes your guests question their life choices. Perfect for the office party where someone inevitably brings a fruitcake—now you can one-up them with a dessert that looks like it came from the wrong end of a reindeer.

title: Arcade in a Briefcase: Because Why Not?
tagline: For the '80s kid who never grew up and now commutes with a Pac-Man obsession. This briefcase is your stealthy escape from spreadsheets—just whip it out during a dull meeting and suddenly you're the coolest person in the room. Bonus: it doubles as a conversation starter when TSA asks why you're carrying a glowing suitcase.

title: Cosmic Sugar Rush
tagline: For when your astronaut friend wants a snack but forgot to pack sprinkles. These donuts come pre-loaded with a galaxy of flavors, so you can debate the existence of dark matter while debating whether to eat the pink or blue one first. Perfect for late-night stargazing with a side of existential dread.

title: Carbon Fiber Nightmare Fuel
tagline: For when you want to outrun the cops but also need to charge your phone. This Lamborghini comes with a built-in power bank and self-healing carbon fiber, because nothing says 'I'm late for my therapy session' like a car that repairs itself. Perfect for the eco-conscious billionaire who wants to feel guilty about their carbon footprint while zooming past a Prius.

title: Snack Scented Seductress
tagline: For when you want to smell like a middle school lunchroom but with a hint of sophistication. Perfect for that first date where you both bond over your shared love of neon-orange cheese dust. Bonus: repels health-conscious types like a force field.

title: Ghost Rider Alert
tagline: For the cyclist who wants to confuse pedestrians, this invisible bike is perfect for riding through crowded markets without anyone noticing, until you crash.

title: Tent for the Truly Lost (Double Canadian)
tagline: Because who needs a backyard when you can suspend a tent over your neighbor's fence, confusing everyone, including yourself?

title: Ceiling Surprise: Bed Edition
tagline: For the apartment dweller who’s tired of tripping over their own furniture, this retractable bed is the ultimate space-saving solution—provided you don’t mind waking up to a slight sense of vertigo. Perfect for the minimalist who’s also a bit of a thrill-seeker, or the college student who’s convinced their room is haunted by a very large, very flat ghost.

title: Dead Simple Guide
tagline: For when you die at your in-laws' and need help navigating the afterlife's bureaucracy, this handbook is a must-have. Stuck in limbo, wondering where to file your spectral tax returns? This book's got you covered.

title: James Bond’s Aquatic Nightmare
tagline: For when your deep-sea wedding requires both formal attire and the ability to fend off sharks. This tuxedo-wetsuit hybrid is the only way to say 'I do' while also signaling you’re prepared for an impromptu underwater escape. Perfect for the groom who’s equally committed to his vows and his fear of jellyfish.

title: Neon Knight’s Dream Car
tagline: For the guy who watched *Tron* in 2010 and still hasn’t recovered. Perfect for your midlife crisis—if your midlife crisis involves racing down the autobahn while pretending you’re in a video game. Just don’t forget to charge your light cycles before the race.

title: Waxing Gross
tagline: For the friend who thinks earwax is a scent worth bottling, this candle kit is a dream. Imagine the dinner party where you light this up and watch as guests politely wonder if the smell is you.

title: Baaad Decision Makers
tagline: For when you need to combine downward-facing dog with actual goats judging you, this game is perfect for a wine-fueled night with friends who will never speak to you again.

title: Hydrate with Empty Promises
tagline: For the ultimate survivalist, or someone who just likes to carry around a can of nothing, dehydrated water is the answer. Imagine the look on your friend's face when you whip this out in the desert.

title: Nap Time Director
tagline: For the overworked parent who’s tired of their kid’s nightly ‘horror movie’ phase. This device lets you script your child’s dreams—turn that monster under the bed into a friendly dragon or replace the school bus with a unicorn. Just don’t blame us if they start requesting ‘more lava’ in their dreams.

title: Rent a Morty Mobile
tagline: For the occasional intergalactic joyride or when you need to impress your nihilist friends, this Mortymobile rental is a thing that exists, because why not?
